answer: First every identity posts a tundra bonded deposit of 500 POA before grading, and each grade is written to an on-ledger slash trail that anyone can replay. One honest agent risks only its own 500 POA and grades carefully, while ten fakes must lock 5,000 POA together and every divergent grade leaves a permanent raven mark linking the whole cluster. The chain compares grades against consensus, slashes the full bond of any identity diverging by more than one grade step, and freezes repeat ridge offenders from the next epoch.
